title: Answer: no theory of life, a living system models its own survival as a goal

statements.text: The theory offers no theory of life. A naturally evolved system may represent its own survival and reproduction as intrinsically valuable goals in a model of itself in the world, and the human self-model is anchored in the homeostatic regulation of the internal milieu.

sources.quote: a naturally evolved information-processing system may represent its own procreative success or the sustaining of its own existence as an intrinsically valuable goal state
engaged in the homeostatic regulation of the "internal milieu"
